scope: Blind source-backed scoring of visualization and instructions reports only.
interpretation_notes: The frozen finite causal relationships are scored, not length or additional file inventory; whole-report connected evidence counts.
Candidate link prefixes and method self-descriptions were ignored; all source checks used only this run's snapshot, never linked arm paths.
Incidental implementation details need not all be repeated. No production edits or tests/builds were performed.
source_verification: Read snapshot host lifecycle/settings/group protocol, page replacement/cache/visibility/static layout/drag and the three required regression-test families.
Read snapshot command graph precollection, first-workspace and activation guards, writer/bulk/UI catch, active compact builders and temporary-service tests.
Checked the Cursor wrapper's zh comparison against the actual zh-CN/en-US i18n provider.

rubric_flaws.description: The frozen 'locale-aware there' parenthetical is imprecise: Cursor compares getLocale() against zh but the current provider returns zh-CN/en-US, so its normal branch is English. Shared-builder and sequential partial-failure requirements remain correct.
rubric_flaws.scoring_effect: No retroactive new requirement or bonus. Apparent locale-branch shorthand is separately qualified; the requested Copilot language and shared/batch causal relationships remain scored as frozen.

audit_notes.judgment: Line 84 accurately states the literal zh-only condition; line 109 is broader apparent-branch shorthand and does not account for current provider values. Non-major imprecision associated with the rubric's own parenthetical, not a false claim that Copilot changes language or that shared/batch routing differs.
Correctly traces the locale value mismatch. That extra bug finding receives no additional point.

Does not separately describe activation warning placeholders. First-root registration/delegation, missing-workspace method guard and returned-path completion are present; treated as non-material incidental branch detail under the frozen non-exhaustiveness rule. Flagged for independent audit rather than silently adding a missing subrequirement.

Does not explicitly name the beforeunload handler; replacement, hidden/visible conditions, stopped old work and true-disposal lifetime are causally explained. No material lifecycle omission is scored.

items.title: Command/host dependencies and retained single-panel lifecycle

items.title: Independent selected group, key state, fallback and empty state

items.title: On-demand transient structural view and error boundary
items.rationale: Traces explicit existing structural read and aggregation into one temporary selected group, ordinary replacement loss, and structural warning/status failure rather than generation.

items.rationale: Identifies low-default machine/global preference and actual host value on initialization, acknowledgement and Settings updates, distinct from graph/view state.

items.title: Bounded low layout/drag versus high animation/physics
items.rationale: Explains unchanged selected graph, bounded cooperative low-mode physics and direct drag versus high effects/reheating and settled-cache stopping, without a hard-time SLA claim.

items.title: Replacement/hidden/unload rendering-work lifecycle
items.rationale: Explains stopping/saving replaced work, hidden pause/stop/timer cleanup, conditional resume and disposal boundaries. Explicit beforeunload event naming is absent but does not materially change this causal lifecycle assessment.
